title: 第851章 渡劫巅峰第850章 见大师兄
slug: 我在修仙界竟然苟成大佬
content_zh:
宁知初听完神色平静半点意外都没有。她端起茶盏又喝了一口慢悠悠地开口：这点修为不算什么。我临走前给三人各留了大批高阶丹药灵宝布阵材料和功法心得，资源堆得足足的。要是这般供给还突破不了元婴，那我反倒要怀疑他们修行不用心了。
百里楚尧被她这句话逗得失笑：也就你敢这般大手笔供给弟子。寻常长老收徒顶多给几件中阶法器撑场面，你直接塞灵宝极品丹丸和高阶功法心得，徒弟们的起点直接甩开同辈十条街。
他笑着摇头但眼底全是真切的欣慰：不过话说回来三个孩子心性都稳，没有被海量资源养出骄纵性子。每日练剑炼丹炼器推演阵法从不偷懒，月儿炼丹失败还会自己复盘写心得记了厚厚一本，齐天佑炼器锤坏了一柄锤子自己又打了一柄新的接着用，楚君卿推演阵法在练功房里一坐就是好几天天不出门。这份心性才是最难能可贵的。
宁知初闻言心头一暖眼底的笑意真切了几分：这点我倒是放心。三人本性都踏实只是缺少历练。等我飞升之前再多给他们留一批资源，日后修行能少走不少弯路。
说完徒弟她话锋一转顺势说起东华大陆的见闻。九大洲域的辽阔格局八大顶尖宗门的盘踞之势、遍地天才修士的密度、各式各样稀奇古怪的奇特禁地——会下灵雨的谷地会让人变幼稚的山谷会倒流时间的古域会说话震出灵力回音的石崖——她挑着有意思的讲了不少，时不时穿插一些路上的趣事和遇到的有趣人物。百里楚尧听得津津有味时不时追问细节，眼底闪着原来外面这么大的惊叹光芒。
最后她说到墨炎真尊的消息。师父在东华秘境闭关顺利抵达飞升临界点，已经成功渡过飞升天劫去了仙界。她讲得简略但关键信息一个没落——秘境机缘、境界突破、飞升过程、最后的告别。
百里楚尧听完沉默了数息。他端着茶盏的手微微收紧了一下又慢慢松开，然后长长地呼出一口气来。脸上那种因为听了太多新奇见闻而一直保持的兴奋神色此刻沉淀下来变成了一种更深沉的、带着长久牵挂终于落定了的释然与欣喜。
师父能顺利飞升真是天大的好事。他开口时声音比方才轻了些但里面的情感分量重了很多，我一直悬着一颗心生怕他在陌生大陆遭遇凶险。如今总算能彻底放下心了。
他低头看了看杯中浅碧色的茶汤又抬头望向暮色中凌霄峰连绵的山影，目光里有怀念也有安心：师父在仙界那边应该一切都好吧。也不知他老人家到了仙界第一件事是干什么。
宁知初想了想自己那位师父的性子然后认真地答了一句：大概先找个地方住下来然后去看看仙界的天有多高。
百里楚尧被她这句看看天有多高说得愣了一瞬然后笑了出来。他摇了摇头把杯中剩余的茶一饮而尽，然后提壶给两人重新斟满。
他说，再喝一杯。这壶茶今晚咱们喝完了它，明日我再去找找有没有更好的藏货。
宁知初端起杯跟他碰了一下。
百里楚尧端着茶盏盯着宁知初看了好几息，目光在她周身转了一圈又一圈。他越感知越心惊，那些隐晦的、被压得极深的气息在他合体初期的感知中如同隔着一层厚雾看山，只隐约知道那山高得离谱却完全看不清全貌。
他终于忍不住开口问了：对了师妹，你如今到底是什么修为？我完全探查不透你的境界。当初你动身跨界时还是合体期，这才不过几十年光阴，怎么会藏得这么深？
宁知初浅浅一笑放下茶盏，没有刻意隐瞒也没有绕弯子，直白回道：渡劫巅峰。早就卡在这个境界许久了。到了东华大陆之后没有天道桎梏束缚，积攒的底蕴彻底释放，顺势就推到了。
渡劫巅峰？！百里楚尧端着茶盏的手猛地一抖，茶水差点又洒了出来。他整个人呆住了足足三息，然后长长地倒吸了一口凉气才找回自己的声音，咂舌道，这速度也太过离谱了！寻常修士卡在渡劫期万年不得寸进，你短短几十年直接走到此界天花板，说出去整个大陆都没人敢信！
宁知初摆摆手神色平静得很：我从前在神隐大陆被禁制压着，刻意压制境界多年积攒了海量底蕴。修为一直在往上涨但因为上限锁死了所以全堆在丹田里面存着，如同一座蓄满了水的坝。到了东华放了开束缚突破自然顺畅，算不上多稀奇。那些底蕴本来就该是我的，只是被这边压着迟到了几十年而已。
百里楚尧连连摇头显然不认同她算不上稀奇的说法但也没有继续争辩。他感佩地叹了一声然后换了个话题：那师兄的修为在你面前大概不值一提了。我如今卡在合体初期巅峰打磨根基许久，距离合体中期只差一层薄纱，却迟迟没能捅破那层关卡。
宁知初闻言抬眼认真看了看他。她的神识在百里楚尧周身轻轻地扫过一遍如同流水漫过河床，将所有经脉灵力心境的状态都清晰地映照在感知之中。然后她笑着开口宽慰道：师兄是实打实一步一个脚印苦修上来的，根基扎实得没有半分捷径。你这身修为是从无数次练剑无数场实战里一剑一剑打磨出来的，比那些靠着丹药和机缘堆上去的合体期修士稳固了太多。突破中期只是时间问题，但你心里清楚瓶颈不在灵力的积累上吧？

百里楚尧微微一怔随即点头：你说得没错。我灵力早就够了，丹田充盈经脉通透，按理说突破中期只是顺水推舟的事。可每次尝试冲击那层壁障的时候总感觉差了那么一点什么，像是有一条无形的线卡在那里。
宁知初想了想然后认真问道：师兄冲击壁障的时候，是怎么做的？
百里楚尧如实回答：运转凌霄剑诀的第三重心法，将灵力沿着主经脉推入丹田核心，等灵力蓄满七成的时候引动剑意震荡周天，借剑意之力将壁障直接冲破。但每次灵力蓄到七成之后剑意凝聚时总会有一瞬的迟滞，就是在那一瞬间壁障重新加固，冲击便失败了。
content_en:
Ning Zhichu looked calm after hearing this and was not surprised at all. She picked up the tea cup and took another sip and said slowly: This level of cultivation is nothing. Before I left, I left each of the three of them with a large amount of high-level elixir and spirit treasure formation materials and tips on how to use the techniques. The resources were quite piled up. If such a supply cannot break through the Nascent Soul, then I have to suspect that they are not paying attention to their cultivation.
Baili Chuyao was amused by her words: You are the only one who dares to provide for your disciples so generously. Ordinary elders can only recruit disciples with a few mid-level magic weapons to support the scene. If you just buy Lingbao's top-quality pills and high-level skills, the starting point of the disciples will be ten blocks ahead of their peers.
He smiled and shook his head, but his eyes were full of genuine relief: But having said that, the three children have a stable temperament and have not been nurtured by massive resources to become arrogant. He was never lazy when practicing swords, alchemy, and weapon refining every day and deducing formations. Yue'er would review and write down his experience when he failed in alchemy and memorized it in a thick book. Qi Tianyou broke a hammer while refining weapons and made a new one and used it again. Chu Junqing sat in the practice room to deduce formations and didn't go out for several days. This character is the most valuable thing.
When Ning Zhichu heard this, his heart warmed and the smile in his eyes was a bit real: I feel relieved about this. All three of them are down-to-earth in nature but lack experience. If I leave some more resources for them before I ascend, my practice will avoid many detours in the future.
After talking about her apprentice, she changed the subject and talked about what she had seen in Donghua Continent. The vast layout of the nine continents, the dominance of the eight top sects, the density of talented monks everywhere, all kinds of weird and strange forbidden places - valleys where spiritual rain can make people childish, valleys where time can be turned back, ancient domains where words can resonate, and stone cliffs where spiritual energy echoes - she talked about a lot of interesting things, interspersed with some interesting things on the road and interesting people she met. Baili Chuyao listened with interest and asked for details from time to time, his eyes shining with astonishment as much as before.
Finally, she talked about the news about Zhenzun Mo Yan. Master successfully reached the critical point of ascension in retreat in Donghua Secret Realm, and has successfully passed through the tribulation of ascension to the fairy world. She spoke briefly but the key information was missing - secret opportunity, realm breakthrough, ascension process, and final farewell.
Baili Chuyao was silent for a few breaths after hearing this. His hand holding the tea cup tightened slightly and then slowly loosened it, and then let out a long breath. The excitement on his face that had been maintained after hearing too many new things now settled down and turned into a deeper sense of relief and joy that a long-term concern was finally settled.
It is a great blessing that Master can ascend smoothly. When he spoke, his voice was softer than before, but the emotional weight in it was much heavier. I was always worried that he would encounter danger in a strange continent. Now I can finally feel relieved.
He looked down at the light green tea soup in the cup and then looked up at the continuous mountain shadows of Lingxiao Peak in the dusk. There was nostalgia and reassurance in his eyes: Master, everything should be fine over there in the fairy world. I don’t know what the first thing he did when he arrived in the fairy world.
Ning Zhichu thought about the temperament of his master and then answered seriously: Probably find a place to live first and then go see how high the sky is in the fairy world.
Baili Chuyao was stunned for a moment by her words "Look how high the sky is" and then laughed. He shook his head and drank the remaining tea in the cup, then carried the pot to refill it for the two of them.
He said, have another drink. Let's finish this pot of tea tonight, and I'll go look for something better tomorrow.
Ning Zhichu picked up the cup and clinked it with him.
Baili Chuyao held the tea cup and stared at Ning Zhichu for several seconds, his eyes circling around her. The more he sensed it, the more frightened he became. Those obscure and deeply suppressed auras were like looking at a mountain through a layer of thick fog in his early stage of integration. He only vaguely knew that the mountain was ridiculously high but could not see the whole picture at all.
He finally couldn't help but ask: By the way, junior sister, what are you doing now?What kind of cultivation is it? I can't detect your state at all. When you set out to cross the border, you were still in the integration stage. It was only a few decades ago. How could you hide it so deeply?
Ning Zhichu put down the tea cup with a faint smile, without deliberately concealing anything or making any detours, and replied directly: "The peak of transcending tribulation." I have been stuck in this realm for a long time. After arriving in Donghua Continent, there were no shackles of heaven, and the accumulated foundation was completely released, and it was pushed along.
The peak of tribulation? ! Baili Chuyao's hand holding the teacup shook suddenly, and the tea almost spilled out again. He was stunned for three full breaths, and then took a long breath before he found his voice, smacking his tongue and saying, this speed is too outrageous! Ordinary monks are stuck in the tribulation period for ten thousand years and cannot make any progress. You have reached the ceiling of this world in just a few decades. No one in the entire continent would believe it!
Ning Zhichu waved his hands and looked very calm: I used to be suppressed by the ban in Shenyin Continent. I deliberately suppressed my realm for many years and accumulated a lot of information. The cultivation level has been rising, but because the upper limit is locked, it is all piled up in the Dantian, like a dam full of water. When I arrived in Donghua, I let go of my restraints and made breakthroughs naturally and smoothly, which is not too strange. Those foundations should have been mine, but I was forced to be late for decades.
Baili Chuyao shook his head repeatedly, obviously not agreeing with her not-so-unusual statement, but he did not continue to argue. He sighed with admiration and then changed the topic: That senior brother's cultivation is probably not worth mentioning in front of you. I am now stuck in the early stage of integration and have been polishing the foundation for a long time. I am only one thin layer away from the middle stage of integration, but I have not been able to break through that level.
When Ning Zhichu heard this, he raised his eyes and looked at him seriously. Her consciousness gently swept over Baili Chuyao's body like water overflowing the river bed, clearly reflecting all the meridians, spiritual energy, and state of mind in her perception. Then she smiled and said with relief: Senior brother has worked hard step by step, and his foundation is so solid that there are no shortcuts. Your cultivation has been honed from countless sword practices and countless actual battles, and it is much more stable than those monks in the Fusion Stage who relied on pills and chance. It's only a matter of time before you break through to the middle stage, but you know in your heart that the bottleneck is not the accumulation of spiritual power, right?
Baili Chuyao was slightly startled and then nodded: You are right. My spiritual power has already been sufficient, and my Dantian is full and my meridians are clear. It stands to reason that breaking through to the middle stage is just a matter of smooth sailing. But every time I try to hit that barrier, I always feel like there's something missing, like there's an invisible line stuck there.
Ning Zhichu thought for a while and then asked seriously: What did senior brother do when he attacked the barrier?
Baili Chuyao answered truthfully: The third core method of running the Lingxiao Sword Technique pushes the spiritual power along the main meridians into the core of the Dantian. When the spiritual power reaches 70%, it triggers the sword intention to shake the surrounding sky, and uses the power of the sword intention to directly break through the barrier. But every time after the spiritual power reaches 70%, there will always be a moment of lag when the sword energy is condensed. At that moment, the barrier is re-reinforced and the impact fails.
